description: RIGHT curved dao REVERSE HORIZONTAL waist-height cut: right forearm crosses front of chest, torso/hips rotate together, empty LEFT palm counterbalances, grounded feet. One blade, not a shovel upward.
RIGHT curved dao straight FORWARD chest-height thrust, natural elbow extension and planted leading foot, LEFT empty guard.

Low forward planted lunge with TWO held gold ringblades, ONE ring in EACH hand. RIGHT leading ring at chest height, LEFT reserve ring beside left waist. Neither is released. Correct hips and knees, gown follows body, no third ring in hands.
BARE TWO-PALM FORWARD PUSH: both EMPTY open palms extended at chest height, elbows still slightly bent, grounded low front knee and coherent spine. No weapons or gauntlets.
BARE LEFT PALM STRIKE at chest height toward target, RIGHT EMPTY palm retracted safely near right ribs. Anatomical LEFT strikes, not the right. Feet planted, same broad torso/head.

Heavy RIGHT massive gold-inlaid DAO DOWN-FORWARD DIAGONAL CUT finish. Hilt has descended from right shoulder to low forward/left side, rigid blade attached, knees grounded, LEFT empty balance. No rising uppercut.

Heavy RIGHT massive dao REVERSE HORIZONTAL cut across waist from left flank toward right outside hip. Coherent shoulder/hip turn and planted leading foot, LEFT empty balance. Same one big curved saber.
RIGHT curved blood saber REVERSE HORIZONTAL cut across front at waist height, connected right wrist/hilt, LEFT empty counterbalance. Hips turn with shoulders, no full backward spin.

BREATHING ACTIVATION: both original red-black GAUNTLETED fists drawn in front of lower chest, elbows beside ribs, knees softly flexed and spine upright. No hand strike or raised knee, no sustained shielding, brief breathing command.
LEFT gauntlet/fist straight FORWARD punch at chest height, RIGHT fist retracted at RIGHT ribs, shoulders/hips coherent and forward planted boot. Preserve exact original gauntlet design.
RIGHT gauntlet/fist LONG straight FORWARD punch at chest height with low grounded lunge, LEFT fist at left ribs. Same original gauntlets, no empty palms or uppercut.
LEFT red folding fan REVERSE HORIZONTAL sweep across front at waist/chest height, fingers stay at fan ROOT/hub, RIGHT hand EMPTY at right ribs. Hips turn with shoulders, not an upward scoop.
RIGHT broad blood saber REVERSE HORIZONTAL waist-height cut across chest, RIGHT wrist on original hilt, LEFT empty balance. Coherent torso/pelvis, no extra sword.
RIGHT broad saber straight FORWARD chest-height thrust with planted forward boot and modest hip hinge, LEFT empty palm near left ribs, not an upward scoop.

RIGHT broad saber decisive finishing DOWN-FORWARD cut ending low beside opposite flank, lowered knees and front boot firmly planted; LEFT empty palm counterbalances. Distinct low grounded finish, not uppercut.

Two hands spaced on ONE plain wooden STAFF push straight FORWARD chest height, rounded wooden ends without blade. Rear RIGHT hand pushes butt, leading LEFT hand guides. Coherent forward lunge with planted boot.

Two-handed ONE plain wooden STAFF REVERSE HORIZONTAL strike across waist/chest, both grips remain spaced on one continuous shaft. Pelvis turns with shoulders, rounded ends, no spear tip or two handles.

Two-handed ONE mechanical CROSSBOW BODY BASH forward at chest height. RIGHT trigger/stock grip, LEFT supports forward UNDERSIDE. Stock, bow arms and mechanism remain one assembly, leading knee bent and grounded. Not firing and not a sword or firearm.

Two-handed ONE SPEAR steady straight FORWARD chest-height thrust. Leading LEFT guides shaft, rear RIGHT pushes butt, hands spaced; rear knee bent, front boot grounded. One metal spearhead and one plain butt, blue tassel.

Two-handed ONE SPEAR heavy finishing FORWARD chest-height thrust with deeper front knee bend and rear leg extending, shoulders/pelvis all face target, no broken spine, hands spaced. No upward sword swing.

Two-handed ONE SPEAR HORIZONTAL shaft sweep at waist height. Both hands spaced on continuous straight shaft; metal spearhead on ONE end and plain butt on other. Hips turn with shoulders, no second head or double handle.

RIGHT WHITE-FEATHER fan with BLACK tips REVERSE HORIZONTAL sweep from left chest to right outside hip, right fingers stay at GOLD ROOT. LEFT EMPTY palm counterbalances; scholar head/beard/hat original scale. Not red folding paper fan.
